messages:
maria: quick follow-up on the model-version/pinning RFC: we need to decide how small the rollout metadata payload should be for client resolvers. my preference is to keep the required surface tiny to reduce churn and parsing complexity.

samir: +1. propose required keys: model_id, version_hash, cohort_label, grace_window_secs. everything else moves to an optional hints blob or telemetry-only fields.

elena: ops concern: routing needs release_origin and model_family in some cases for tiered routing. we can't silently drop those for infra consumers. can we make them optional but stable?

maria: idea: required minimal keys, plus an optional freeform field called resolver_hints that clients MUST ignore unknown keys from. gives forward compat without blowing up older clients.

release-bot: deploy: rolling canary for "min-meta-v0.2" schema change started 1/10 hosts.

devex-james: sample minimal payload for docs:
```json
{
  "model_id": "redwood/gpt-13b",
  "version": "a1b2c3d4",
  "cohort": "canary-02",
  "grace_secs": 300
}
```

samir: compatibility rules: clients older than v1.4 must leniently ignore unknown fields. if a required field is missing then resolver fallback ordering WILL be: tenant_pin -> last_known_mapping -> global_default. we should document this explicitly.

elena: telemetry/metrics proposal: emit applied_version from control plane as an internal metric instead of embedding it in the payload to keep metadata small and avoid leaking control-plane decisions.

maria: rollout triggers (kept out of payload): canary -> ramp by weight -> automatic rollback if latency > +10% or eval-quality drop > 2% vs baseline. triggers are part of rollout policy not metadata.

devex-james: ops nicety: include an integrity header on writes so clients can detect partial writes e.g. X-RWMD5: <hex>.

release-bot: canary metrics snapshot: latency +3%, error-rate stable, p95 unchanged. monitoring continues.

elena: pin precedence open question: what beats what? client-pin vs tenant-minimum vs org-enforced minimum? propose enum pin_precedence default: CLIENT > TENANT > GLOBAL but tenants can lock override via org-policy.

maria: decision summary: adopt minimal schema v0.2 with required keys [model_id, version, cohort, grace_secs]. add optional resolver_hints freeform block. publish resolver_contract doc, add control-plane validation webhook, and include migration notes in RFC follow-up.

samir: ack 1 I'll add lenient parsing and fallback order in the python/js libs.

devex-james: I'll update quickstart and examples, call out resolver_hints, show X-RWMD5 usage.

maria: thanks all. tagging @elena for ops playbook and tenant-override policy follow-up. :thumbsup:
